alnage.definition:
n. Measurement (of cloth) by the ell; also, a duty for such
   measurement.
alnage.translation: n. 毛织品检验；毛织品检验费

alnager.definition:
n. A measure by the ell; formerly a sworn officer in England,
   whose duty was to inspect and measure woolen cloth, and fix upon it a
   seal.
alnager.translation: 旧时英国毛织品检验官

alni.translation: (=aluminium-nickelcobalt alloy)铝镍(磁铁, 永磁)合金

alnico.definition: n. trade name for an alloy used to make high-energy permanent magnets; contains aluminum and iron and nickel plus cobalt or copper or titanium
alnico.translation:
n. 阿尔尼科永磁合金, 磁钢
[化] 铝镍钴磁钢

alniflex solution.translation: [化] 阿尔尼夫莱克斯溶液(用于核燃料后处理首端过程的浸取液)

alnisi.translation: 阿尔尼西铁镍铝硅合金
